about_the_game:
What is Phase Pal?

Phase Pal transforms your desktop into a lively, interactive experience with animated characters powered by local AI. Chat, role-play, and personalize your workspace with characters that react, engage, and entertain, making every interaction uniquely immersive.

Why choose Phase Pal?

Discover engaging digital companionship with Phase Pal. Each character comes alive with fluid, lifelike animations and responds to your interactions, creating endless possibilities for role-playing, conversation, and fun. Leverage built-in AI technology, including local LLM support, ensures your experience is private, customizable, and tailored. Customize and mod your characters, or explore our ever-growing library to find your perfect digital companion.

Interactive, Smart, and Fun

  • Lively Animated Characters: Watch your desktop come alive with characters who move naturally, follow your mouse cursor, sit on windows, and entertain you with playful interactions.

  • AI-Powered Conversations: Chat freely with your characters using real-time AI powered by text and voice integration. Engage in natural conversations, immersive role-play, or casual banter whenever you like.

  • Local LLM Integration: Keep interactions personal and private with optional local LLM support. Customize personalities and behaviors to create your perfect desktop companion.

  • Complete Modding Support: Upload and share your custom-made characters. Become part of a vibrant community constantly expanding the Phase Pal universe.

Core Features:

  • Smooth, always-on-top desktop overlay with intuitive controls

  • Engaging real-time chat and role-playing functionality

  • Easy Steam account linking and model management website

  • Extensive modding community and support

  • High-quality 3D animations and interactive behaviors

Characters Currently Available

  • Default Avatar Start your Phase Pal journey immediately with our charming default character, featuring full interactive animations and chat support.

  • Community Avatar (Coming Soon) Look forward to upcoming characters created by the community, each bringing unique personalities and voices.

Future Updates & Roadmap

Phase Pal is continually evolving. Expect new officially licensed characters, enhanced AI integration, advanced customization options, and community-driven content regularly. Your desktop companion experience will only get richer and more engaging over time.

Platform Features

  • Stunning, high-quality graphics

  • Robust AI conversations and dynamic role-playing scenarios

  • Extensive character modding and customization support

  • Free default character included with additional community characters available

Transform your desktop into an interactive playground, meet your new AI-powered assistant today with Phase Pal!

content_descriptors.notes: Phase Pal features anime-style mascots and supports user uploaded 3D models, which may include stylized or revealing designs typical of anime aesthetics that some may consider mature.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U 1.6GHz / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Bring your desktop to life with beautifully animated characters powered by real-time AI chat. Enjoy a fun, interactive, always on top overlay featuring characters you can customize, chat with, and role-play. Choose local LLMs for privacy or connect to online AI services for more features.
